criticism: The 'foreignBuy' function does not have a balance check before minting tokens, allowing an attacker to overflow the balance of the investor.
The 'foreignBuy' function does not check if the ICO is in progress, allowing attackers to exploit it before the ICO starts.
The 'finish' function does not have a balance check before minting tokens, allowing an attacker to overflow the balance of the investor.
The 'finish' function does not check if the ICO is finished, allowing attackers to exploit it after the ICO ends.
The 'initialInvestor' function uses a predictable value as a seed, allowing attackers to predict it and exploit it.
